versions.changelog:
Initial release of Lead Research Assistant skill.

- Identifies and qualifies high-quality leads based on your product/service and ideal customer profile.
- Provides actionable outreach and contact strategies, including personalized messaging and conversation starters.
- Ranks and prioritizes leads with a fit score, offering decision-maker details and LinkedIn URLs when available.
- Supports both plain-text and codebase-driven business analysis.
- Includes clear output formatting and options for CRM integration and follow-up research.
